strategy.gamePlan: You are not playing Yu-Gi-Oh!, you are playing a clock. 4000 life points is a short number: Ojama Trio plus Secret Barrel is 1500 off one activation, and Wave-Motion Cannon left alone for four turns ends the game by itself. Survive, count, and do not take a single avoidable point of damage.
openingPriorities: Set Wave-Motion Cannon turn one and leave it. Every turn it sits is 1000 damage you do not have to draw into.
Ojama Trio is a burn card, not a stall card. Resolve it before Secret Barrel, never after.
Keep one defensive trap up at all times. A single unanswered attack step is a third of your life total.
keyInteractions: Dark Room of Nightmare adds 300 to every effect burn — including each Ojama token destroyed by Secret Barrel.
Des Koala flips for 400 per card in the opponent's hand, so flip it before they commit, not after.
Draining Shield gains you more life than most beaters deal, which buys the two turns Wave-Motion Cannon needs.
Cosmic Cyclone costs you 1000 life. In this deck that is a real price — only fire it at a card that beats you.

matchups.notes: They out-clock you. You need an early Draining Shield and a Trio into Barrel to have a game at all.
Their removal is aimed at monsters you do not play. Their clock is slow enough for the Cannon.
Big bodies, no reach, no backrow removal. Just Desserts scales with everything they want to do.
